candidate_scope_policy.writable: Only the selected function's implementation file after human review

functions.correctness_proposal: Independent 2x2 chroma-subsampling and color-transform specification; check channel order, rounding, saturation, odd ROI, strides, null pointers, and plane boundaries.
functions.priority_rationale: Image-domain representative with an isolated output and a large gap in untracked exploratory single-thread data; that data is not formal evidence.

functions.api_correspondence: MATCHING_INPUT_OUTPUT_SHAPE; alpha handling and color coefficients require review
functions.correctness_proposal: Independent YUV420 specification; check ignored alpha, channel order, chroma averaging, rounding, saturation, even ROI, strides, and status codes.
functions.priority_rationale: Single function file and measurable exploratory gap; vendor compatibility on the target is still unverified.

functions.api_correspondence: MATCHING_INPUT_OUTPUT_SHAPE; packed channel order requires review
functions.correctness_proposal: Independent RGB-to-packed-YUV422 reference; check pair order, chroma sharing, odd width, row stride, rounding, and bounds.
functions.priority_rationale: Small, explicit packed-pixel operation with a modest exploratory gap.

functions.api_correspondence: MATCHING_INPUT_OUTPUT_SHAPE; source halo and border policy require review
functions.correctness_proposal: Independent scalar maximum over a 3x3 neighborhood; check halo ownership, ROI offset, non-contiguous rows, floating edge values, and status codes.
functions.priority_rationale: Mathematically simple oracle and clear image-processing kernel; exploratory performance is near parity.

functions.api_correspondence: MATCHING_INPUT_OUTPUT_SHAPE; color coefficients and packed channel order require review
functions.correctness_proposal: Independent packed-YCbCr422 conversion reference; check color matrix, shared chroma, rounding, saturation, odd width, stride, and status codes.
functions.priority_rationale: Fair direct API pair and easy isolation; exploratory performance is near parity.

benchmark_proposal.workload: One shared image input, ROI, strides, seed, process resources, and sampling plan per operation
benchmark_proposal.bindings: Separate package/evaluator adapters for IPPI-FT and HMiPPI types, status codes, and symbols; no data conversion inside timed calls
benchmark_proposal.timing: Use the same harness and interleaved samples on one target; record each resolved shared-library path and SHA-256
benchmark_proposal.source: The untracked benchmark/hmppi_vs_ippi_20260921 is development evidence only and uses patched compatibility copies in historical S5000C runs
